mcqs.question: Where was Andhra Pradesh's first international-standard boxing ring inaugurated on 29 June 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The first international-standard boxing ring in Andhra Pradesh was inaugurated at the Srinivasa Sports Complex in Tirupati. Fatorda Stadium, Estadio Azteca and MetLife Stadium were associated with football events, not this boxing facility.

mcqs.question: Which group of countries jointly hosted the FIFA World Cup 2026, the first edition with three hosts?
mcqs.explanation: The FIFA World Cup 2026 was hosted by the USA, Canada and Mexico, marking the first World Cup with three host countries. The other combinations do not represent the 2026 host group.

mcqs.keyword: Tournament format; Number of teams and groups
mcqs.question:
With reference to the FIFA World Cup 2026, consider the following statements:
1. It was the 23rd edition and the first World Cup with three host countries.
2. It featured 48 teams divided into 12 groups of four.
3. It introduced the Round of 16 for the first time.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the tournament was the 23rd edition, had three hosts, and featured 48 teams in 12 groups of four. Statement 3 is incorrect because the Round of 32, not the Round of 16, was introduced for the first time.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the French Open 2026 is incorrect?
options: Alexander Zverev won the men's singles title.
Mirra Andreeva won the women's singles title.
The men's doubles title was won by Marcel Granollers and Horacio Zeballos.
The French Open is the only Grand Slam tournament played on grass.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the French Open is played on grass; it is the only Grand Slam tournament played on clay. Alexander Zverev, Mirra Andreeva, and Marcel Granollers with Horacio Zeballos were the stated singles and men's doubles winners.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): India secured its first-ever gold medal at the World Rowing Cup in June 2026.
Reason (R): Havildar Lakshya and Havildar Ujwal Kumar Singh won the Lightweight Men's Double Sculls event at World Rowing Cup III.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the assertion and reason are true, and the reason explains the assertion. The Indian Army pair won the Lightweight Men's Double Sculls at World Rowing Cup III, giving India its first-ever gold at the World Rowing Cup.

mcqs.question: Which country topped the medal table at the ISSF Junior World Championship held in Suhl, Germany, in June 2026?
mcqs.explanation: India topped the ISSF Junior World Championship medal table with 25 medals, including 7 gold, 8 silver and 10 bronze. Individual Neutral Athletes finished second with 14 medals and Italy third with 10.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: R. Praggnanandhaa won Norway Chess 2026 with 17 points.
Statement B: FIDE was established in 1924 in Zurich.

Which one of the following is correct?
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. Praggnanandhaa won Norway Chess with 18 points, while FIDE was established in 1924 in Lausanne, not Zurich.

mcqs.question: Who was the only Indian included in the inaugural TIME100 Most Influential People in Sports list in the Titans category?
mcqs.explanation: Smriti Mandhana was the only Indian included in the inaugural TIME100 Most Influential People in Sports list, in the Titans category. Jaspal Rana, Lionel Messi and Viswanathan Anand were separately mentioned in the sports news facts.

mcqs.question: The indoor boxing hall associated with Andhra Pradesh's first international-standard boxing ring at Tirupati received support from which organisation?
mcqs.explanation: Junior Chamber International (JCI) supported the indoor boxing hall. SAI, FIFA and SAFF are different sports organisations and were not identified as the supporting organisation for this facility.

mcqs.question: For the FIFA World Cup 2026, where were the opening match and the final scheduled, respectively?
options: Fatorda Stadium, Margao; Estadio Azteca, Mexico City
MetLife Stadium, USA; Estadio Azteca, Mexico City
Estadio Azteca, Mexico City; MetLife Stadium, USA
Estadio Azteca, Mexico City; Fatorda Stadium, Margao
mcqs.explanation: The FIFA World Cup 2026 opening was scheduled at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, while the final was scheduled at MetLife Stadium in the USA. Fatorda Stadium was associated with the SAFF Women's Championship final, not the FIFA World Cup.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the FIFA World Cup 2026 and FIFA:
1. Mexico became the first country to host the FIFA World Cup three times.
2. Argentina entered the FIFA World Cup 2026 as the defending champion.
3. FIFA was established in 1904 in Zurich, and its President was Gianni Infantino.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct: Mexico hosted the World Cup for the third time, Argentina was the defending champion, and FIFA was established in 1904 in Zurich with Gianni Infantino as President. The options omitting one statement incorrectly leave out a fact about the tournament or FIFA.

mcqs.question:
Match the following details relating to the SAFF Women's Championship 2026 and SAFF.

List-I
 a. India's title
 b. Score in the final
 c. Year and place of SAFF's establishment
 d. Number of SAFF members

List-II
 i. Record 6th title
 ii. 3–1
 iii. 1997, Dhaka
 iv. 7

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-i, b-ii, c-iii and d-iv: India won its record sixth title, defeated Bangladesh 3–1, and SAFF was established in 1997 at Dhaka with seven members. The other codes interchange the title, score, establishment details and membership count.

mcqs.question:
Match the French Open 2026 doubles events with their winners.

List-I
 a. Women's doubles
 b. Mixed doubles
 c. Women's doubles winning pair's first nationality
 d. Mixed doubles winning pair's nationality

List-II
 i. Kateřina Siniaková / Taylor Townsend
 ii. Sara Errani / Andrea Vavassori
 iii. Czechia and USA
 iv. Italy

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The women's doubles title went to Kateřina Siniaková and Taylor Townsend, while the mixed doubles title went to Sara Errani and Andrea Vavassori. Their listed national associations are Czechia and USA for the women's pair and Italy for the mixed doubles winners.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements about Indian performances in the listed June 2026 sporting events are correct?

1. India finished second at the Asian U-20 Athletics event with 19 medals.
2. India won the FIH Women's Nations Cup for the second time and qualified for the FIH Pro League.
3. India defeated Japan 4–1 in the U-18 Hockey Asia Cup, with Ashish Tani Purty scoring a hat-trick.
4. India's women won silver in the U-18 Hockey Asia Cup after defeating South Korea 3–0.
mcqs.explanation: Only statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct, so the answer is Only three. In the U-18 Hockey Asia Cup, India's women won bronze, not silver, despite defeating South Korea 3–0.

mcqs.question:
Match the events and details from the Asian athletics, wrestling and relay championships.

List-I
 a. U-17 Asian Wrestling venue
 b. Number of categories in which Indian women won medals
 c. 2nd Asian Relay Championships venue
 d. Host of the 2027 edition of the Asian Relay Championships

List-II
 i. Da Nang, Vietnam
 ii. 10
 iii. Shaoxing, China
 iv. Chandigarh

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct matching is Da Nang, Vietnam–10 categories–Shaoxing, China–Chandigarh. The U-17 Asian Wrestling event was held at Da Nang, Indian women won medals in all 10 categories, the relay championships were held at Shaoxing, and Chandigarh will host in 2027.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Viswanathan Anand was India's first Grandmaster.
Reason (R): Viswanathan Anand was a five-time world champion.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the assertion and the reason are true: Anand was India's first Grandmaster and a five-time world champion. His five world titles do not explain why he was India's first Grandmaster, so the second option is correct.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The SAI–University of Tsukuba sports cooperation MoU was signed for three years.
Statement B: The SAI–University of Tsukuba sports cooperation MoU was signed for four years.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is correct because the SAI–University of Tsukuba MoU was for three years. Statement B changes the duration to four years, whereas the correct duration was three years.

mcqs.question: Who won the women's title at the Asian Individual Chess Championship 2026 held in Ulaanbaatar?
mcqs.explanation: Savitha Shri Bhasker won the women's Asian Individual Chess Championship 2026 with 7.5/9 points on a tie-break. Kang Xiangrui won the open title, while R. Praggnanandhaa and Viswanathan Anand were not the women's champion.
